messages.en:
{07 00 00}I was going to you a prize
but {01 00 00 05 00}{07 16 00}your pockets are full!
You can't carry anymore!
{07 14 00}Come back when you've taken
care of that stuff,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma tahtsin sulle auhinna
anda, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 16 00}su taskud on täis!
Sa ei jaksa enam kanda!
{07 14 00}Tule tagasi, kui oled selle
kraamiga tegelenud,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I thought that maybe I
should give you something
for winning but
{07 16 00}it looks like you have too
much stuff already,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Go deal with all your
stuff and then come talk
to me again, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma mõtlesin, et võiksin
sulle võidu eest midagi
anda, aga
{07 16 00}tundub, et sul on juba
liiga palju kraami,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Mine tegele oma kraamiga
ja tule siis minuga
uuesti rääkima, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
So,{01 00 00 05 00} I was prepared to give
you something in the off
chance that you won but{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
You're{01 00 00 05 00} already carrying too
much stuff, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{01 01 00}
Go deal with that first.
messages.et:
Nii,{01 00 00 05 00} ma olin valmis sulle
midagi andma juhuks, kui
sa võidad, aga{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
Sa{01 00 00 05 00} kannad juba liiga
palju kraami, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{01 01 00}
Tegele sellega enne.
